(Orange)** shows how domain plugins expand from 2 initial domains to 6 domains (14 skills) and deepen in place (upgrading ECC from `initial` to full v3 verification). - `MathRSI v3 · Current` has the widest column and a bold teal highlight border; `v4+ ...` sits on the far right as a compact dashed continuation badge. 2. **Bottom-to-Top Maintenance Loop (`mathrsi-meta-evolve`)**: - The existing implementation (`v1`/`v2`) plus **two distinct evidence boxes** feed the violet `mathrsi-meta-evolve` bar at the bottom, which sends upward `Base + plugin updates` arrows into `MathRSI v2` and `MathRSI v3 · Current`. - **Left evidence input (`Historical DD Archive`)** feeds the `v1` $\rightarrow$ `v2` transition as an independent historical archive (no arrow from `v1` into the DD archive). - **Right evidence input (`v3 Evidence Inputs`)** feeds the `v2` $\rightarrow$ `v3` transition, explicitly distinguishing the new source packages (`Erdős 86`, `Ruskey–Savage Q6`, `Happy Ending`) from Explicitly shows how MathRSI starts by inspecting the problem statement or existing workspace (`FORMAL_SPEC.md`, `NEXT_SESSION.md`), recognizing the mathematical object and active obligation, selecting the matching domain plugin from the 6 domains (or running Base alone), and entering at the right stage (including direct entry to `04 Verify` / `lean-formalize` for formal-only tasks). 2. **Orchestrator, Multi-Agent Delegation & Cross-Model Review Callouts (Above the 5 Stages)**: - **`mathrsi-research` (Root Orchestrator)** sits above the 5 stages as the single owner of stage transitions. - Directly beneath Root and linked into Stages `02`, `03`, and `04` are two explicit operational strips: - **Left strip (Teal) — Multi-Agent Collaboration**: `Root delegates bounded, exclusive-scope tasks to Parallel Workers` $\rightarrow$ `immediately consumes returned proofs, certificates, counterexamples, or gaps at the original caller`. - **Right strip (Violet) — Cross-Model Adversarial Review (via MCP)**: `Fresh cross-model reviewers challenge routes (02) and audit proofs (04)` $\rightarrow$ `feed concrete revisions` (with explicit boundary: `Review ≠ deterministic check or Lean`). 3. **Center 5-Stage Solving Spine (`01 Prepare` $\rightarrow$ `02 Route Loop` $\rightarrow$ `03 Prove` $\rightarrow$ `04 Verify` $\rightarrow$ `05 Handoff`) + Return Loops**: - Embeds the 4 v3 base actions directly inside their owning stages (`02 Route Loop`, `03 Prove`, `04 Verify`). - Preserves the three adaptive return paths: `Targeted literature lookup` (`02`/`03` $\rightarrow$ `01`), `Rethink route` (`03` $\rightarrow$ `02`), and `Local verify / Repair gaps` (`04` $\leftrightarrow$ `03`). 4. **Active `research-wiki` Loop Bar (Spanning All 5 Stages)**: - Positioned immediately below the 5 stages with **bidirectional vertical arrows (`Read / Write`) into every single stage (`01`–`05`)**, replacing the old passive bar with the concrete 4-step cycle (`Locate` $\rightarrow$ `Read full entities` $\rightarrow$ `Serial write` $\rightarrow$ `Read back & reuse`). 5. **Domain Plugins Bar (Orange, 6 Cards) & Separate Outer Maintenance Bar (Violet)**: - Below the wiki bar, the orange **Domain Plugins** band shows all 6 v3 domains connected via bidirectional dashed orange arrows to the stages (`Task workspace: read/write | Plugin archive: read-only`). - At the bottom, the violet **`mathrsi-meta-evolve`** band remains visually separate from the solving spine, showing evidence classification and in-place maintenance between tasks. --- ## 2. • **Upward arrows:** Base + plugin updates | 46 | *(Note: Excluding bullets/numerals, Figure 1 displays **188 words**—compact enough for clean 16:9 rendering while explicitly naming all four v3 base upgrades and all six v3 domains.)* --- ### Figure 2: Exact Displayed Text (`194 words` total) | Region / Box | Exact Displayed English Text | Words | | :--- | :--- | :---: | | **Title** | **Inside MathRSI v3: Problem Routing, Multi-Agent Solving & Wiki Memory** | 10 | | **Entry & Routing Gate (Top-Left)** | **1. Crucial Simplifications That Preserve Semantics To ensure GPT Image renders legible typography without hallucinating or garbling dense technical strings, four deliberate design simplifications are applied: 1. **Matrix Alignment in Figure 1 Instead of Nested Sub-Boxes**: - In the v2 evolution diagram (`01-evolution.png`), each version column stacked 4–5 full-width inner cards; adding a 4th column (`v3`) with 6 domain cards inside the same vertical stack would crush font sizes below readability. - Splitting each version column into **two horizontal bands** (**Track 1: Shared Base Workflow** on top; **Track 2: Domain Plugins** on bottom) lets `v1` and `v2` summarize already-established plugins on one compact line (`Property B · Degree–Diameter`) while giving `v3 · Current` generous vertical room for the **4 base actions** and the **upgraded ECC + 3 new domains**. 2. **Dropping Internal Python / Skill Sub-Filenames in Favor of Mathematical Roles**: - Instead of crowding boxes with long script names (`check_q4_candidate.py`, `check_forest_rank.py`, `lean-boundary.md`, `dd-obstruction-certificate`), the labels name the **exact mathematical mechanism** (`Working-set vs. full-domain & accepted_best`, `172-class, pair & Lean checks`, `Q6 forest rank`, `Explicit Lean-premise & axiom audits`). The README tables immediately below the figures already provide clickable file-level links. 3. **Operationalizing the Wiki Bar as a 4-Step Horizontal Flow with 5 Vertical Connectors**: - Rather than writing a separate wiki paragraph inside each of the 5 stage boxes (which would double the text inside Stages `01`–`05`), Figure 2 places **bidirectional `Read / Write` arrows between all five stages and a single 4-step `research-wiki/` pipeline bar** (`Locate` $\rightarrow$ `Read full pages` $\rightarrow$ `Serial write` $\rightarrow$ `Read back & reuse`). This visually proves that every stage reads and writes the task wiki using original ARIS entities (`papers · ideas · experiments · claims`) without whole-archive dumping. 4. **Dedicated Collaboration & Adversarial Review Strips Above Stages 02–04**: - Putting **Parallel Workers** (teal) and **Cross-Model Adversarial Reviewers via MCP** (violet) as two coordinated callout strips between `mathrsi-research` and Stages `02`–`04` avoids tangling internal stage return arrows (`Rethink route`, `Local verify / Repair`) while making multi-agent delegation and vendor-neutral MCP adversarial review immediately visible at first glance. --- ## 4. Short Factual Risk Check (Root Verification Checklist) When generating and inspecting the two GPT Image renders, check these eight concrete factual boundaries: 1. **`v3` Is Current and Implemented; `v1` and `v2` Are Fixed Snapshots**: - `MathRSI v3` must be labelled **`Current`** (solid border, active column), while future evolution is shown as a small dashed continuation (`Future v4+ ...`) on the far right. 2. **ECC Status Across Versions (`Initial` in `v1`/`v2` $\rightarrow$ `Upgraded` in `v3`)**: - In `v3`, **ECC must never be labelled `draft`**. In Figure 1, `v1` and `v2` can label ECC as `initial`, while `v3` explicitly labels it **`UPGRADED: ECC`** (and Figure 2 shows `ECC (Upgraded)` alongside the other 5 plugins). 3. **Provenance of Historical & New Research Evidence (No False Benchmark Claim)**: - In Figure 1, the arrows from `Historical DD Archive` and `v3 Evidence (Erdős 86, Q6, Happy Ending archives + ECC v1/v2 continuation)` must point **into `mathrsi-meta-evolve`**, not out of `v1` or `v2` as if those historical packages were autonomous benchmark runs executed by an earlier release. 4. **No Claim That Model Weights Change**: - Evolution arrows from `mathrsi-meta-evolve` must state **`Base + plugin updates`** / **`Modify in place`**, never "model training" or "weight updates". 5. **Adversarial Review $\neq$ Proof Acceptance or Deterministic / Lean Verification**: - In Figure 2, the violet **Cross-Model Adversarial Reviewers (via MCP)** strip must stays vendor-neutral (no hard-coded model vendor lock-in) and explicitly note **`Review ≠ deterministic check or Lean`**. 6. **Direct Lean Entry & Explicit Premise Audit in `04 Verify`**: - Figure 2 must show that formal-only tasks can route directly into `04 Verify` (`Optional/direct Lean`), and that `04 Verify` audits **explicit theorem premises alongside `#print axioms`**. 7. **Task Workspace vs. Read-Only Plugin Archive**: - Figure 2’s wiki and plugin bands must preserve the boundary: **active task `research-wiki/` is read/written across all 5 stages** by a serial stage writer, whereas **plugin archives and historical wikis are read-only**. 8. **`mathrsi-meta-evolve` Is Separate Outer Maintenance, Not Stage 06**: - In Figure 2, `05 Handoff` must **not** have a direct sequential stage arrow into `mathrsi-meta-evolve`; outer maintenance remains in its own bottom container (`Authorized Between Tasks`).

Crucial Simplifications That Preserve Semantics To ensure GPT Image renders legible typography without hallucinating or garbling dense technical strings, four deliberate design simplifications are applied: 1. **Matrix Alignment in Figure 1 Instead of Nested Sub-Boxes**: - In the v2 evolution diagram (`01-evolution.png`), each version column stacked 4–5 full-width inner cards; adding a 4th column (`v3`) with 6 domain cards inside the same vertical stack would crush font sizes below readability. - Splitting each version column into **two horizontal bands** (**Track 1: Shared Base Workflow** on top; **Track 2: Domain Plugins** on bottom) lets `v1` and `v2` summarize already-established plugins on one compact line (`Property B · Degree–Diameter`) while giving `v3 · Current` generous vertical room for the **4 base actions** and the **upgraded ECC + 3 new domains**. 2. **Dropping Internal Python / Skill Sub-Filenames in Favor of Mathematical Roles**: - Instead of crowding boxes with long script names (`check_q4_candidate.py`, `check_forest_rank.py`, `lean-boundary.md`, `dd-obstruction-certificate`), the labels name the **exact mathematical mechanism** (`Working-set vs. full-domain & accepted_best`, `172-class, pair & Lean checks`, `Q6 forest rank`, `Explicit Lean-premise & axiom audits`). The README tables immediately below the figures already provide clickable file-level links. 3. **Operationalizing the Wiki Bar as a 4-Step Horizontal Flow with 5 Vertical Connectors**: - Rather than writing a separate wiki paragraph inside each of the 5 stage boxes (which would double the text inside Stages `01`–`05`), Figure 2 places **bidirectional `Read / Write` arrows between all five stages and a single 4-step `research-wiki/` pipeline bar** (`Locate` $\rightarrow$ `Read full pages` $\rightarrow$ `Serial write` $\rightarrow$ `Read back & reuse`). This visually proves that every stage reads and writes the task wiki using original ARIS entities (`papers · ideas · experiments · claims`) without whole-archive dumping. 4. **Dedicated Collaboration & Adversarial Review Strips Above Stages 02–04**: - Putting **Parallel Workers** (teal) and **Cross-Model Adversarial Reviewers via MCP** (violet) as two coordinated callout strips between `mathrsi-research` and Stages `02`–`04` avoids tangling internal stage return arrows (`Rethink route`, `Local verify / Repair`) while making multi-agent delegation and vendor-neutral MCP adversarial review immediately visible at first glance. --- ## 4. Short Factual Risk Check (Root Verification Checklist) When generating and inspecting the two GPT Image renders, check these eight concrete factual boundaries: 1. **`v3` Is Current and Implemented; `v1` and `v2` Are Fixed Snapshots**: - `MathRSI v3` must be labelled **`Current`** (solid border, active column), while future evolution is shown as a small dashed continuation (`Future v4+ ...`) on the far right. 2. **ECC Status Across Versions (`Initial` in `v1`/`v2` $\rightarrow$ `Upgraded` in `v3`)**: - In `v3`, **ECC must never be labelled `draft`**. In Figure 1, `v1` and `v2` can label ECC as `initial`, while `v3` explicitly labels it **`UPGRADED: ECC`** (and Figure 2 shows `ECC (Upgraded)` alongside the other 5 plugins). 3. **Provenance of Historical & New Research Evidence (No False Benchmark Claim)**: - In Figure 1, the arrows from `Historical DD Archive` and `v3 Evidence (Erdős 86, Q6, Happy Ending archives + ECC v1/v2 continuation)` must point **into `mathrsi-meta-evolve`**, not out of `v1` or `v2` as if those historical packages were autonomous benchmark runs executed by an earlier release. 4. **No Claim That Model Weights Change**: - Evolution arrows from `mathrsi-meta-evolve` must state **`Base + plugin updates`** / **`Modify in place`**, never "model training" or "weight updates". 5. **Adversarial Review $\neq$ Proof Acceptance or Deterministic / Lean Verification**: - In Figure 2, the violet **Cross-Model Adversarial Reviewers (via MCP)** strip must stays vendor-neutral (no hard-coded model vendor lock-in) and explicitly note **`Review ≠ deterministic check or Lean`**. 6. **Direct Lean Entry & Explicit Premise Audit in `04 Verify`**: - Figure 2 must show that formal-only tasks can route directly into `04 Verify` (`Optional/direct Lean`), and that `04 Verify` audits **explicit theorem premises alongside `#print axioms`**. 7. **Task Workspace vs. Read-Only Plugin Archive**: - Figure 2’s wiki and plugin bands must preserve the boundary: **active task `research-wiki/` is read/written across all 5 stages** by a serial stage writer, whereas **plugin archives and historical wikis are read-only**. 8. **`mathrsi-meta-evolve` Is Separate Outer Maintenance, Not Stage 06**: - In Figure 2, `05 Handoff` must **not** have a direct sequential stage arrow into `mathrsi-meta-evolve`; outer maintenance remains in its own bottom container (`Authorized Between Tasks`).
